step1_analysis.description: A current-mode operational amplifier typically used in low-voltage bandgap references. It utilizes a pseudo-differential current input stage with diode-connected NMOS transistors to allow operation at a 1-V supply without tail current headroom issues, achieving virtually zero systematic offset through symmetrical current mirroring.

paper_reference.title: Curvature-Compensated BiCMOS Bandgap with 1-V Supply Voltage

sky130_expected.reasoning: Higher supply voltage (1.8V vs 1V) and different bias point leads to higher power than reported.

sky130_expected.calculation: Rout = ro_p || ro_n = 175k || 175k = 87.5k. Rin = 1/gm_n = 1.75k. Gain = Rout / Rin = 50 V/V = 34 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on channel length modulation (lambda) of SKY130 devices at L=0.5u.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = Rout = 87.5k Ohm. In dB Ohms: 20*log10(87.5k) = 98.8 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to the output resistance of the current mirrors.

sky130_expected.calculation: Channel length modulation effects cancel out when Vout = VDD/2 = 0.9V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The symmetrical topology ensures virtually zero systematic offset, naturally centering the output.

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2*pi*Rout*Cload). Assuming ~50fF parasitic load, f = 1 / (2*pi*87.5k*50f) = 36 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is limited by the high output impedance node and parasitic capacitances.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for Current-Differencing Amplifier measuring DC power, transimpedance gain, voltage gain, bandwidth, and input impedance.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Current-Differencing Amplifier

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM1 N3 N3 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 N5 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 N1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 N5 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N4 N6 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N6 N3 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N6 N6 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N4 N1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

Vvdd N0 0 1.8
Vvdd_bulk VDD 0 1.8
Vgnd_bulk GND 0 0
Vn2 N2 0 0
Vbias N5 0 0.9

* DC stabilization for high-impedance output node
Vmid Vmid 0 0.9
Rdc N4 Vmid 100MEG

* AC Input Currents (Differential 1A total)
Iin_p 0 N3 DC 0 AC 0.5
Iin_m 0 N1 DC 0 AC -0.5

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power_w = -i(Vvdd) * 1.8
  let vout_dc = v(N4)
  print power_w vout_dc

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1 10G
  
  * Transimpedance gain (V/I)
  let tz_gain_db = vdb(N4)
  
  * Voltage gain (V/V)
  let v_diff = v(N3) - v(N1)
  let v_gain_complex = v(N4) / v_diff
  let v_gain_db = 20 * log10(mag(v_gain_complex))
  
  * Input impedance
  let rin = mag(v(N3)) / 0.5
  
  meas ac tz_gain_max find tz_gain_db at=10
  meas ac v_gain_max find v_gain_db at=10
  meas ac rin_val find rin at=10
  
  * Bandwidth
  let tz_gain_3db = tz_gain_max - 3
  meas ac bw_hz when tz_gain_db=tz_gain_3db fall=1
  
  * Phase margin
  let phase_deg = 180/PI * cph(v_gain_complex)
  meas ac phase_margin find phase_deg when v_gain_db=0 fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
